description: A JSON number too large for hashicorp/hcl's exponent range becomes infinity
notes: The spec says a JSON number is translated exactly within the constraints of the information model, which requires an error when an integer can't be represented precisely or a number overflows. hashicorp/hcl parses numbers with go-cty's ParseNumberVal (parseNumber in json/parser.go), and Go's big.Float overflows to infinity while scaling by the exponent (Float.setExpAndRound in math/big); exponents from 2^31 on are rejected instead, as the native syntax's numbers tests show.
